goal: Stop SummonScout Engine V2 queue-wrapper accumulation across HOT fanout generations by canonicalizing api.queuePartySummon back to the deepest raw core queue and publishing exactly one managed ownership wrapper.
shared_resources: SummonScout Engine V2 queue API ownership
notes: Root cause: EngineV2FoundationHot resets persisted S.api to nil on every execution, making its same-generation raw-queue guard unreachable after HOT reload. A previous publicQueue wrapper can therefore become the next generation rawQueue and wrappers accumulate until C stack overflow. The integrated fix adds a final HOT API anchor that recursively unwinds known rawQueue closures, republishes one ownership-equivalent queue wrapper, restores raw ownership on Shutdown, and self-verifies that api.queuePartySummon remains anchored.
